description: Free-tier endpoint. DraftKings betting splits on the main game lines (moneyline, spread, total): for each side, handle_pct (share of DraftKings Sportsbook's own customers' money) and bets_pct (share of their bet count), with the current point and American price. These are DraftKings customers only, not the whole betting market. Useful for: 'where is the money on DraftKings for the Chiefs game'.

sport_key.description: football_nfl, basketball_nba, hockey_nhl, baseball_mlb, basketball_wnba, mma_ufc, football_ncaaf, basketball_ncaab, basketball_ncaaw, soccer_epl, soccer_uefa_champions_league, soccer_uefa_europa_league or soccer_mls.
